version_definition: S0 initial; S1... are first-seen content hashes; revision attempts recorded separately; Final aliases selected sealed content, not another run
comparison_limitations: Independent official evaluation is one fresh run per content, not causal proof or repeated-sampling success probability.
Official check units are reporter_group, not necessarily individual assertions.
GT deltas require matched executor, reporter source, unit and total; item identities are not supplied by report.json.
Surrogate deltas require an identical test_hash. Program errors and absent item reports remain NOT_MEASURED.
Early stopping creates no later versions. Trial and population fixed denominators are separate; missing values are not fabricated zero scores.
